BG_APOTHEOSIS.title: Apotheosis
BG_APOTHEOSIS.description: Your starter Strikes deal 1 more damage and your starter Defends give 1 more [gold]Block[/gold].
BG_APPARITION.title: Apparition
BG_APPARITION.description: You can't lose more than 1 HP this turn.
BG_BLIND.title: Blind
BG_DARK_SHACKLES.title: Dark Shackles
BG_DARK_SHACKLES.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] for each enemy that intends to attack you.
BG_DRAMATIC_ENTRANCE.title: Dramatic Entrance
BG_DRAMATIC_ENTRANCE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Deals {Magic:diff()} more on the first turn of combat.
BG_FINESSE.title: Finesse
BG_FLASH_OF_STEEL.title: Flash of Steel
BG_GOOD_INSTINCTS.title: Good Instincts
BG_HAND_OF_GREED.title: Hand of Greed
BG_HAND_OF_GREED.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Deals {Magic:diff()} more if you have 10 or more Gold.
BG_IMPATIENCE.title: Impatience
BG_IMPATIENCE.description: If you have no Attacks in your hand, draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
BG_MADNESS.title: Madness
BG_MADNESS.description: The next card you play this turn costs 0.
BG_MASTER_OF_STRATEGY.title: Master of Strategy
BG_MAYHEM.title: Mayhem
BG_MAYHEM.description: At the start of your turn, play the top card of your draw pile for free.
BG_MIND_BLAST.title: Mind Blast
BG_MIND_BLAST.description: Deal damage equal to the number of other cards in your hand{IfUpgraded:show:, +1|}.
BG_PANACEA.title: Panacea
BG_PANACEA.description: Remove all [gold]Weak[/gold] and [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] from {IfUpgraded:show:ALL players|any player}.
BG_PANACHE.title: Panache
BG_PANACHE.description: At the end of your turn, if your hand is empty, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to any row.
BG_PURITY.title: Purity
BG_PURITY.description: [gold]Exhaust[/gold] up to {Cards:diff()} cards in your hand.
BG_SADISTIC_NATURE.title: Sadistic Nature
BG_SADISTIC_NATURE.description: Whenever you apply [gold]Weak[/gold], [gold]Vulnerable[/gold], or [gold]Poison[/gold] to an enemy, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to it for each.
BG_SWIFT_STRIKE.title: Swift Strike
BG_THE_BOMB.title: The Bomb
BG_THE_BOMB.description: At the end of 3 turns, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
BG_THINKING_AHEAD.title: Thinking Ahead
BG_THINKING_AHEAD.description:
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
Put a card from your hand on top of your draw pile.
BG_TRIP.title: Trip
